items.label: ANT ATTACK
items.why: 76-byte BASIC/bootstrap program calls the ROM tape loader at 0562, loads the headerless main image at 5C00 and hands over at 9700. The main image replaces this bootstrap.

items.label: block 4
items.why: All 41984 bytes equal entry.sna at 5C00-FFFF; it contains the BASIC game, engine, graphics and city map.
